kim hong.name: Kim Hong
kim hong.origin: Kim Hong was a television news personality in New York City, recruited by Moon Knight as "Scout" to be part of his Shadow Cabinet agents and informants. How he earned her allegiance is unknown, and Scout was initially unaware of her boss's identity. Kim Hong was at Brinkstone Prison covering the execution of religious serial killer John DeZoan when Moon Knight infiltrated the prison to confront Demogoblin. A power outage caused by Moon Knight's entry interrupted DeZoan's electrocution, giving him super-powers instead. As Deadzone, DeZoan killed most of the people in the viewing box, including Kim's cameraman. She encountered Moon Knight while trying to get to safety, and learned his role in the Shadow Cabinet for the first time when he called her "Scout". When he feared he was dying, Moon Knight activated the Legacy protocols to find a potential replacement. Scout helped him test one of his possible subjects, Peter Parker.

kim il sung.name: Kim Il Sung
kim il sung.origin: thumb|left|Scrambler attacks Havok The mutant Scrambler is a member of the Marauders, a band of assassins who were gathered together by the mutant thief Gambit at the request of the enigmatic mastermind known as Mister Sinister. Sinister first sent the Marauders to murder the entire population of the underground mutant community known as the Morlocks. In the course of this mutant massacre, the Marauders clashed with the mutant adventurers known as the X-Men and the original X-Factor team. Subsequently, the X-Men thwarted the Marauders' attempt to assassinate Sinister's former pawn, Madelyne Pryor, in San Francisco. Later, Sinister sent the Marauders to battle the X-Men during the time of the demonic invasion of New York City known as the Inferno. The Marauders were all killed, but Sinister possessed samples of their DNA with which to clone them. The Marauders later clashed with the dimensionally-displaced young mutant known as Nate Grey after they attempted to assassinate Sinister's former servant, Threnody; Scrambler was killed in Nate Grey's power burst. Scrambler was again cloned by Mr. Sinister and subsequently retained his mutant powers after M-Day. He returned once again as a member of the New Marauders, alongside old-time members such as Scalphunter and newer members, Sunfire and Exodus. thumb|right|Near-death of Scrambler Both of Scrambler's hands were cut off and he was seemingly killed by X-23 in an attempt to free the newborn mutant messiah from the Marauders; however, he was later revealed to have survived the encounter. In an attempt to live a normal life he began using his abilities to work as an auto mechanic. He received a set of prosthetic hands. Following the foundation of a mutant state in Krakoa by the hand of Charles Xavier and his allies, Scrambler and the other Marauders remained in the clone farm where they had been reborn. They were enslaved and held captive by the Goblin Queen, who planned to use them as foot soldiers for an invasion of Krakoa. Scrambler's former teammate Greycrow and his new team the Hellions destroyed the clone farm and killed Madelyne. Scrambler was killed in the battle, freeing him to be resurrected by the Five.

kim larsen.name: Kim Larsen
kim larsen.origin: Kim Larsen was first officer, first of the Bengal Queen and then of the Eastern Moon. He was the most hated character by the sailors who had to obey his orders. He would beat to death those who he thought were lazy, and then declare that they were dead because they were weak, and he also declared to everyone that he would never die at sea. During his last voyage on the Eastern Moon, he met the Devil who advised him to abandon the ship because it would be wrecked and sunk, confirming to him that it was true that he would never die at sea as thanks for having involuntarily served him. Remaining arrogant even with the Devil telling him that he wasn't afraid of him either, the Devil told him that even if it were true that he would never die there were things worse than death and with the destruction of the ship he ended up at sea to remain a drifts forever without ever finding peace or rest.

kim lewis.name: Kim Lewis
kim lewis.origin: thumb|left|200px|Kim Lewis Kim Lewis was a circus stunt rider who was active during the days of the American Frontier. Suffering injuries while on tour, Kim went to her uncle's cabin to recuperate. Growing bored she developed the identity of the Black Rider to have some fun by holding up coaches, but not robbing them, choosing to commit crimes for the thrill. Her activities as the Black Rider attracted the attention of the Two-Gun Kid who attempted to stop her and was delivered a humiliated defeat instead. Seeing fun in this, she then left a note for her uncle claiming that the Black Rider "kidnapped" her so that the Two-Gun Kid would continue to pursue her. Sure enough, the heroic gunslinger did and was always a step behind the Black Rider. When Two-Gun eventually captured her, he was shocked to find that the Black Rider and Kim were the same person. Furious with her horseplay, Two-Gun gave her a spanking and was determined to tell her uncle. However, after seeing the pair happily reunited and getting a kiss on the cheek from Kim, Two-Gun could not bring himself to tell her uncle the truth and left. thumb|right|200px|Kim gets what she deserved. Kim's subsequent activities are unknown.

kim rhee.name: Kim Rhee
kim rhee.origin: Kim Rhee was an ex-Korean army officer, who led a well-armed gang of Armani-wearing gangsters in the West 80s of New York City. They were involved in the protection rackets and were expanding into policy, stolen goods, and both cigarette & liquor smuggling (all activities in which their Irish rivals the Black Cullens were involved). He was also trying to take over the blocks east of Columbus, increasing tensions with the Black Cullens. Kim invited the leader of the Black Cullens to a sit down, but in reality was planning an ambush. Unfortunately for him, a black kid fired a gun at a group of black teenagers (who had stolen his Jordan shoes), alerting the Black Cullens and setting off a firefight. The Punisher who had been following the Black Cullens, got involved turning it into a 3-way shootout. The end result being all of the mobsters ending up dead.

kimberly dee.origin: Kimberly Dee was a supermodel and later member of the Skrull Kill Krew. Catwalk is one of the victims of the Skrull-turned-cow-turned-hamburger transformation known as Skrullovoria Induced Skrullophobia. Catwalk was a supermodel and discovered her powers while her flight was being hijacked by agents of Hydra. Catwalk disposed of the terrorists all by herself and was soon recruited into the Skrull Kill Krew. Like most of the Skrull Kill Krew, Catwalk has shapeshifting powers, but has the preference to shift into the form of a feline creature, complete with claws, fangs, and enhanced athletic abilities. thumb|left Due to the degenerative properties of the infection, Catwalk, Moonstomp, and Dice's bodies eventually start to rot away. Riot and Ryder preserved their teammates' heads in cryo-stasis. This is done as they know they can only be brought back for one last mission.

fields.history: Kimberly Dee was a supermodel and later member of the Skrull Kill Krew. Catwalk is one of the victims of the Skrull-turned-cow-turned-hamburger transformation known as Skrullovoria Induced Skrullophobia. Catwalk was a supermodel and discovered her powers while her flight was being hijacked by agents of Hydra. Catwalk disposed of the terrorists all by herself and was soon recruited into the Skrull Kill Krew. Like most of the Skrull Kill Krew, Catwalk has shapeshifting powers, but has the preference to shift into the form of a feline creature, complete with claws, fangs, and enhanced athletic abilities. thumb|left Due to the degenerative properties of the infection, Catwalk, Moonstomp, and Dice's bodies eventually start to rot away. Riot and Ryder preserved their teammates' heads in cryo-stasis. This is done as they know they can only be brought back for one last mission.
powers: Catwalk has the ability to shapeshift, and usually chooses to turn into a feline humanoid form with claws.

kimberly potters.name: Kimberly Potters
kimberly potters.origin: Kimberly Potters was a mutant in the year 2099, when an invitation to Xi'an's gathering gave her the opportunity to join his newest incarnation of the X-Men. While at the gathering, Serpentina, nicknamed Tina, met with a scared and confused Timothy Fitzgerald. She greeted him and tried to put him at ease, showing him her powers, and introducing him to the entertainment of the day, the mutant Metalhead. She told him that Xi'an had called them there and told him that he would change his life, but when an assassin fired at Xi'an, and Tim fired a bolt of siphoned energy back at him, ruining his aim, Tina fled along with the other X-Men from the Synge Corporation, who believed that Xi'an had killed their former head, Noah Synge. While a group of the other X-Men broke into the Synge Corporation building to clear Xi'an's name, Serpentina was left behind with Cerebra and Timothy when Junkpile attacked them and stole Xi'an's body, which had cocooned itself to protect itself from injury. Tina jumped on Junkpile, but was thrown towards a chasm, only surviving by grabbing the ledge at the last moment. When the first group was captured, Tina and the remaining X-Men made their way into the Synge Corporation building, themselves. They found Meanstreak and Metalhead floating in stasis gel, but Tina smashed open the containers rather than see her friends imprisoned, and freed them. Together they fought through the building's security forces, towards the office of Lytton Synge, where they ran into Junkpile. Before the rest of the team could form a strategy, Tina leapt forward and attacked him, but he quickly reacted and crushed her face into a concrete wall, killing her. When Xi'an rose from his cocoon, he tried to heal Tina with his newly evolved powers, but he found that he could do nothing for the dead. The X-Men buried Tina in a crystal coffin created by her fellow member, Krystalin. Yet, because she believed so fiercely in Xi'an's vision, her death galvanized Timothy into permanently joining the X-Men. Later, to use her against the X-Men, the Graverobber revived Tina's body and used her as a mindless puppet against Xi'an's team. When one of the other members of the Undead team lured Timothy, now called Skullfire, into an alley, Tina shot and killed him with a poisoned dart, so that Graverobber could revive him to use his powers. When Morphine Somers tricked the Graverobber by planting a bomb on the hostage he demanded, and destroyed him, Tina was freed from his spell and fell dead once again. The X-Men then cremated her and spread her ashes to the wind so that she could never be revived again.

kimberly schau.first_appearance: Mutant Misadventures of Cloak and Dagger Vol 1 9
kimberly schau.origin: Kimberly Schau was one of the eight volunteers recruited by M-Branch, a secret government program aiming to create artificial superhumans. Exposed to cosmic rays and/or gamma rays, she developed energy manipulation abilities and was given the codename Dazzler, in honor of the presumed-dead X-Man. Like her teammates, Schau suffered from severe radiation poisoning due to the unstable experiments. When Roland Blaisdell deemed X-Force expendable, she fought alongside her team to escape. However, during the ensuing conflict, she was shot and killed by M-Branch soldiers before she could make it to safety. Her sacrifice played a crucial role in motivating the surviving X-Force members to turn against M-Branch and fight to expose its unethical experiments.

kimberly vesco.name: Kimberly Vesco
kimberly vesco.origin: Kimberly Vesco had been born in Salem but had been orphaned as an infant and adopted by a couple in Chicago, where she was raised until her teenage years with no knowledge history of her past or where she was from originally. Salem was a town split between magic-using families referred to as "Wicks" and those without magical abilities, called "Blanks". After a "wick" with precognitive powers, Francis Foley started predicting an unspecified disaster coming to Salem, Foley used a spell to summon Vesco, believing her to be the "fulcrum", a kind of magical savior. Vesco's family moved to Salem, unknowingly under the influence of Foley's spell, where she had trouble fitting in at first. Many of her classmates, and Vesco herself, believed Vesco to be a clueless "blank" and were skeptical that she was the savior Foley believed her to be. After discovering her own magical necromancy powers and barely escaping multiple attacks from a mysterious Thief, Vesco was taken under the guidance of Foley, his friends LB Harrington and Mink, their rival coven Mason Kaleema, Paul Aristides, and Ren Lowell, as well as the ghosts of David Knox and Sally Sherman, two of the Thief's former victims. The group took Vesco to the Pillar of Smoke, a magical artifact and source of the Salem "wicks" powers, where they were attacked by the Thief, revealed to be their classmate Chad Barrow, a magical mutant with the power to steal and control other's magics. Barrow left the group for dead and used the power of the Pillar to take control of all the wicks in Salem, intending to steal all their magic and use it to resurrect Sally Sherman, who had been Barrow's ex-girlfriend and first victim. Vesco and her allies had survived and returned as a group to oppose Barrow. Vesco used her necromancy powers to free the resurrected Sherman from Barrow's control. Uninterested in returning to life at the mercy of the man who murdered her, Sherman magically attached herself to Barrow and dragged him with her into the Realm of the Dead. As the group left the scene, triumphant, Foley mentioned that he was predicting "something worse" coming, to which Vesco expressed confidence that they'll be ready. Vesco was listed as "Status undetermined" by Tony Stark in his post-Civil War case files.

kimeiko ashu.name: Kimeiko Ashu
kimeiko ashu.origin: Kimeiko was a member of the South Vietnamese Street Gang the Poison Memories. He slept with Namorita after meeting her in a club after a night of drinking. The next morning, Ashu stole her address book, which contained the names of her fellow New Warriors members' names and home addresses. With the address book, he and his crew kidnapped Nova's brother Robert Rider and Speedball's father Justin Baldwin. 2 units of the gang defied Ashu's orders and murdered Rage's grandmother Edna Staples and shot Firestar's father Bart Jones. In exchange for not killing Justin Baldwin and Robert Rider, many of the New Warriors turned themselves into the Poison Memories. It was revealed that Ashu had once offered to spare the lives of Silhouette's fellow gang members in the Concrete Dragons if Silhouette agreed to become his fourteen year old sex slave. Silhouette had rejected the offer, which presumably cost her the lives of some of her friends. Night Thrasher was alerted to the New Warriors' decision to hand themselves over to the Poison Memories by Hindsight Lad who went to the same high school as Speedball and had been blackmailing him into membership into the New Warriors. Hindsight Lad alerted Night Thrasher who went to rescue his former team. Kimeiko had arranged the kidnappings to get back at Night Thrasher for crushing the Poison Memories gang by revealing their leader Gai No Don was a North Vietnamese general who butchered the South Vietnamese. Ashu had hoped to shatter Night Thrasher's illusion of family (the New Warriors) the way his own family (the Poison Memories) had been shattered. Kimeko was confronted by Night Thrasher who at this point had saved the New Warriors and Ashu's hostages. Ashu attacked the group in a suit of armor created by A.I.M. The suit overheated, and the New Warriors were incapacitated by the blast. Before Ashu could use a piece of shrapnel to kill Night Thrasher, Rage fell through the ceiling window and attacked Ashu, demanding revenge for the murder of his grandmother. Night Thrasher begged the 14 year old Rage not to kill Ashu, but Rage refused and snapped Ashu's neck. Later, at a hearing, Night Thrasher as Dwayne Taylor lied to protect Rage, and Rage was found not at fault and released into Dwayne Taylor and Andrew Chord's custody.

kimura.name: Kimura
kimura.origin: ===Origin=== Kimura was born to an abusive alcoholic father and a negligent mother. Her life at home also mimicked her life at school, where she was also abused and tormented by her peers. Later, she came under the care of her loving grandmother, who tried to heal the emotional damage inflicted upon Kimura through nurturing, love, and understanding. However, by that point, the emotional scars were permanent and her grandmother's attempts to reach her were futile. After her grandmother's fatal heart attack, Kimura took off, eventually coming into contact with the Facility. She then underwent some procedures that granted her indestructible skin and density control. She then exacted revenge against those in her past who had wronged her. During her time at the Facility, Kimura eventually assumed the same abusive role as the people who victimized her in the past, particularly with X-23. ===The Facility=== As an agent of the Facility, Kimura became X-23’s handler. She abused X-23, finding any excuse to bully her, regardless of whether X-23 failed or not. After X-23 escaped the Facility, Kimura made it her duty to track down X-23, bring her back to the Facility, and kill anyone X-23 had come in contact with. 200px|thumb|left|Meeting X-23 She eventually tracked X-23 to San Francisco, where Laura lived with her Aunt Debbie and her cousin Megan. During a raid on Debbie’s house, Kimura broke X-23’s neck. She then used adamantium handcuffs to handcuff herself to Laura and drag her downstairs, where Debbie and Megan were hiding. There, she began to put her finger through Megan's chest. However, Laura recovered from her injuries, cut off her own hand, and handcuffed Kimura to a pipe. Then, while Debbie and Megan ran, Laura cut open a gas pipe and turned on the pilot light, causing an explosion. ===Encounter with the New X-Men=== Thanks to her enhancements, Kimura survived and returned to the Facility, with a deeper hatred for X-23 than ever. Eventually, the Facility put their eyes on the mutant Mercury, so they could experiment on her. When Mercury left the Xavier School grounds with X-23, Kimura and her team targeted her. Kimura and X-23 fought, but she injured Laura and escaped with Mercury. 200px|thumb|right|Reunion When Kimura arrived back at the Facility, she enthusiastically watched as they released their new experiment, Predator X, upon the young mutant Mammomax. fields.personality: After finally getting her revenge on the people that tormented her throughout her childhood with the powers she received, Kimura ironically became cruel and arrogant, not caring or even showing a hint of remorse for her actions. She had complete loyalty to the Facility and would go to any length to complete her task regardless of getting innocent people involved, so much so that she even became the Facility's handler and enforcer. She took great pride in her position, mostly because she could harm and intimidate those who got in her and her allies' way. Kimura was also extremely sadistic, taking great and overwhelming pleasure in harming others through torture. Kimura always enjoyed physically and verbally abusing X-23, beating her up whenever she misbehaved or failed a mission that was given to her. Even if Laura obeyed those orders without hesitation and fulfilled the missions she was sent on, Kimura would still abuse her out of exhilaration when she returned. This also showed Kimura as a hypocrite, due to her own past of being abused and she did not even try to sympathize with Laura. Even though she knew full well that their pasts were similar, she didn't even consider the idea that she and Kinney might be the same. Even Emma Frost was deeply disgusted. Kimura was also xenophobic and disliked mutants, as she was happy to see firsthand Mammomax get consumed by the Predator X that Adam Harkins created.

kimura yakuza.name: Kimura (Yakuza)
kimura yakuza.origin: Kimura was the Oyabun of a Yakuza clan that operated within Madripoor from the Sovereign Hotel. He once bought the head of the android Elsie-Dee from Donald Pierce, which he used as an accountant to cook his books. When Elsie-Dee's partner Albert came to Madripoor in search for her, the facial-recognition software at the Madripoor International Airport which was hijacked by the Yakuza misidentified him as Wolverine. Since Wolverine had once killed Kimura's Aniki, Dai Kumo, Kimura sent his special enforcers after Albert for revenge, but they failed to kill him. Albert later attacked Kimura's base to retrieve Elsie-Dee's head after learning from Pierce that it was in the Yakuza's possession. After Albert killed many of his men, Kimura handed him over the head without a fight, but later gathrered his men to avenge the insult to their honor and intercept Albert before he could leave Madripoor. Kimura was also concerned with Elsie-Dee escaping with all his accounting info in her memory banks. During the confrontation with the androids, Albert rammed his getaway vehicle into Kimura's limo. Albert and Elsie-Dee then fended off Kimura's henchmen until Kimura told them to stand down so he could avenge the Yakuza's honor alone and so no one else got hurt. Seeing that Kimura had some honor in him, Albert and Elsie-Dee ceased their attack, and Elsie-Dee erased all of Kimura's bookkeeping info in her memory banks as a peace offering. Kimura then helped the androids escape Madripoor by hiding them in a shipping crate and sending them to Macao in exchange for Albert giving up one of his fingers as penance for his actions against the Yakuza.

kindra.name: Kindra
kindra.origin: While the New Mutants were in Asgard, Cannonball wandered through some tunnels where he came across Kindra and a group of Dwarves being attacked. He rescued them, but while he was defending them, he was shot in the back with a spear. Kendra nursed Sam back to health and in the process they developed feelings for each other. On a later visit to Asgard, Sam managed to get the entire team captured when he ran in without thinking as Kindra was threatened by Hela. Kindra was later freed by the New Mutants and kept hidden from Hela's forces by her father.

kindun.name: Kindun
kindun.origin: Kindun was the ruler of his namesake planet, he shared some kind of connection with it he considered himself and the planet one. When he was a child, Thanos the Mad Titan and his daughter Gamora tried to conquer it but failed. Decades later, Kindun hired Nebula and the Chitauri to hunt down Gamora and bring her to him. However, as soon as she was delivered, her teammates, the Guardians of the Galaxy, and the Avengers arrived to rescue her. Kindun created an earthquake to deal with his enemies, but they used Manifold's teleportation to return to Earth the same way they had arrived, by teleporation. Kindun tried once again to have revenge on Gamora by moving the planet to her base of operations at the time, Spartax. Countless troops of Chitauri descended to Spartax and attacked it. When Gamora arrived to Kindun, she was ambushed, but survived the attack due to her recent power acquisition. She tried to convince Kindun to stop trying to kill her, due to the actions of Thanos not being connected to her own. However, Kidun still tried to murder her. In the end, she forced Kindun to retreat.

king horse.name: King (Horse)
king horse.origin: The horse that was later known as King lived during the days of the American Frontier, alone in a valley near the town of Jackspur. When Randy Clayton's horse Smokey was spooked by a mountain lion and was no longer good to ride, his guardian the Rawhide Kid took the boy to Jackspur to find a new horse. Finding none worth buying they were told by a man about a white stallion in the nearby mountains. The Rawhide Kid and Randy then succeeded in capturing and taming the horse with the help of Apache the Rawhide Kid's own horse. Once the stallion was tamed, Randy decided to name it King after the valley that he seemingly ruled as a king. The horse took the Kid to such places before the horse brought him to Shotgun City where the hero lived for the remainder of his career. King was highly intelligent able to understand even complex instructions. This made the horse sought after by thieves such as Barlow who briefly stole the horse before it was rescued by the Rawhide Kid and Randy. Much later when Rawhide and Randy were helping a Pony Express rider who narrowly avoided being robbed, King sensed the thieves -- the Sloan gang -- not far away and attacked them. Unaware that Sloan and his gang were responsible for the attempted theft, the Kid did not know why King was attacking them. Sloan attempted to use this to his advantage by filing a complaint to Shotgun City's Sheriff Ben Yarby. After a warning from the lawman, Sloan and his men set King loose and committed a series of horse thefts wherever King was spotted making everyone in town think that King had gone rogue, including the Rawhide Kid who failed to capture the horse. While the Sheriff and others were busy searching for King, Sloan and his gang tried to rob the Shotgun City bank, but were stopped by King himself, as witnessed by the Rawhide Kid who took them into custody and had King exonerated. King later came to the aid of his master when Randy was captured by Crack, an outlaw who had a striking resemblance to the Rawhide Kid. Upon Randy's orders, King rode into town and got the real Rawhide Kid who rescued Randy from his lookalike.

king robert.name: King (Robert)
king robert.origin: King was a mutant mercenary in the service of the Kingpin, working in a crew with other two employees known as Knight and Rook. When their boss was doing business with Klaw, Knight and the rest of the team intercepted an assassination attempt on Klaw by Erik Killmonger. They captured him and brought him to the Kingpin, who ordered to have him killed. King saw potential in Erik and recruited him into the crew, occasionally suggesting him to let go of his vengeful nature. Following the successful execution of a multi-target assassination, the Kingpin decided to dispose of them by pitting them against his best mercenary, Bullseye, claiming it was a test of worth. After Bullseye ambushed the four and killed Rook, the rest escaped and King parted ways from Erik and Knight. King retreated to Sofia, Bulgaria where he lived in a cabin with his wife Celia. They were approached by Knight and Erik after Knight had arranged with S.H.I.E.L.D. to facilitate King's capture. Erik wanted simply to warn King about it so he could escape. When freelance agents contacted by Knight arrived, a shoot-out resulted in Celia's death. King was fatally injured and, in his final moments, he gave Killmonger the key to his cabin's cellar where he stored all of his weaponry so he could have revenge on Knight.

king and queen of cards.name: King and Queen of Cards
king and queen of cards.origin: The King and Queen of Cards are the product of Jimmy Jupiter's imagination. They hale from the realm called Nowhere in a area known as the Kingdom of Cards. When Jimmy Jupiter fell asleep while his friends were playing cards for money, he was awoken after his playmates left and the cards came to life and began gathering themselves up to head back home. Upon learning that Jimmy did not gamble, the King and Queen had Jimmy brought to their kingdom. There they told Jimmy that whenever humans play cards for money, they force cards to go to war against each other. After imparting this lesson to Jimmy, they learned from their central intelligence that Jimmy's mother was calling for him and the royals sent Jimmy home. Their subsequent fate is unknown.

king and queen of time.name: King and Queen of Time
king and queen of time.origin: The King and Queen of Time were imaginary constructs created by Jimmy Jupiter in the land of Nowhere. They were the rulers of the Valley of Time, which appeared to be the personification of all time. Their kingdom was visited by Jimmy who was brought there by two sentient clocks who wished to teach Jimmy to value and make the most use of his time. He was brought before the king and queen who showed them their Time Machine -- a device that allowed anyone to see any point in history. When it was learned that Jimmy was a regular time waster, the King and Queen sentenced him to a spanking and sent him to his home. Their subsequent fate is unknown.

king arthur wrestler.origin: King Arthur was a professional wrestelr who won five championships five years straight but his career was ended when an injury robbed him of the use of his legs. He became a trainer for other wrestlers but secretly he also started administering them and himself experimental unstable anabolic steroids to enhance their performances, when one of his trainees, Jumpin' Jack Flash, discovered his criminal activities he took the identity of Mr. X and killed him on the ring, framing Mr. X in the process. His activities were eventually discovered by Captain America who defeated him and had him arrested, clearing Mr. X's reputation.

king bolo.name: King Bolo
king bolo.origin: In the 1940s, King Bolo was the ruler of the Birdmen of the planet Sunev. When explorers Zephyr Jones and Corky Grogan arrived from Earth, it fulfilled the legends that the closely related planets would interact with each other. Zephyr and his comrade were welcomed with open arms by King Bolo, and they exchanged information and technology. However, the jealous General Roudo, a spy for the evil Parrotmen, framed Zephyr and Corky as spying on the Birdmen. With no evidence to the contrary, King Bolo sentenced Zephyr and Corky to be executed the following day. However, the Parrotmen attacked before their sentence could be carried out, and the two proved their innocence by fighting back the Birdmen with their guns and exposing Roudo as the traitor. In the battle's aftermath, Bolo had Roudo executed and thanked the Earthmen for their help. When Zephyr and Corky prepared to leave Sunev, Bolo invited them to return and suggest regular visits to his world. If this invitation has been extended remains unrevealed.

king borna.name: King Borna
king borna.origin: ===King of Valusia=== King Borna was the monarch of Valusia, and allegedly a tyrant. Conspiring against Borna were four-members group made of Baron Kaanuub of Blaal (meant to become king in Borna's stead), Count Ducalon of Komahar, the soldier Eranos, and the poet Ridondo. Ridondo lied to Kull, the commander of the Black Legion, telling him Borna was about to disband the Legion. Kull consequently rushed to the palace, challenged and slew Borna in combat and took the crown from him, to the conspirators' surprise. His body was buried at the Royal Crypts, on the outskirts of the City of Wonders. ===Legacy=== His corpse was later animated by Sekhmet Tharn (as part of a secret plan to raise an undead army of Valusian royalty to attack Kull's Valusia), and faced Kull and Brule who were inquiring disturbances around the Crypts. Unable to defeat him using weapons, Kull toppled a column over Borna, crushing the corpse. During the rule of King Kull, Ralim declared himself the son of King Borna and the rightful heir to the Topaz Throne. To prove Ralim lied, Kull hired Fen Gur to conjure an illusion of an undead Borna who rushed at Ralim, prompting him to reveal in panic his own lies.

king brian.name: King Brian
king brian.origin: King Brian was the king of Charnina, a city-state of Brythunia. For more than fifteen years , Brian was the enemy of King Tomar, a warlord and an ambitious under-king of Hyperborea. Brian was betrayed by Malachi, commander of the Brythunian Cavalry, who was the lover of Queen Kormlada, wife to King Tomar. Malachi agreed to hold back his horsemen to assure Brian's defeat. During the battle, King Brian remained at his tent, while 20,000 Brythunians clashed with an equal number of Hyperboreans. As Conan of Cimmeria, who fought along the Brythunians, was ravaging his army, Tomar fled the battle and managed to enter Brian's tent, and the two kings slew one another. When the Brythunians returned to Charnina, the power vacuum left by King Brian's death led to the rise of Lord Pollus and Lord Ludox, who vied for power, with their respective factions opposing in the streets of the city.

king crocodile.name: King Crocodile
king crocodile.origin: King Crocodile was a massive crocodile indigenous to the jungles of Brazil. By around 1954 the outside world learned of King Crocodile's existed. Famous zoologist Dr. Carle and his daughter Sherry went on an expedition to find King Crocodile. They hired a jungle guide named Jonah, who had no intention in capturing the beast for study, but instead wanted to kill it for sport. When Carle and Jonah argued over the issue, Jonah shot Dr. Carle and left Sherry to fend for herself in the jungle. Incidentally, Shelly was the first person to locate King Crocodile and she found that the beast was actually quite friendly to human beings and she quickly befriended the beast and tried her best to keep it safe. However, Jonah continued to hunt it until he was confronted by the Sub-Mariner and his companion Betty Dean who held Jonah off long enough for King Crocodile to eat him. Discovering Sherry and learning what happened, the Sub-Mariner and Betty Dean helped Sherry arrange to have King Crocodile brought to a reptile sanctuary in Florida so that he would be safe from other hunters. King Crocodile's current status and fate is unknown.

king cycle.origin: King Cycle and his gang nearly ran over Red Wolf and quickly took off during the ensuing struggle, claiming that Red Wolf was "bad news." Red Wolf soon ran into a mohawk policewoman named Jill Tomahawk who had been knocked out by the gang while they were casing a local museum to rob. Tomahawk saw capturing the gang as being her big chance to make a name for herself and to prove that women were just as capable at police work as men. Red Wolf later confronted King Cycle and his gang at the museum, having been tipped off to the robbery by Tomahawk. Just before Red Wolf could finish off the gang, however, Jill showed up and was taken hostage by one of the gang members, forcing Red Wolf to allow them to escape. The bikers trail was soon picked up by Red Wolf's faithful wolf, Lobo, and the pair followed the trail to a large mansion which the bikers used as a hideout. Red Wolf entered the mansion and soon found Jill Tomahawk tied to a large spinning wheel in the basement which spun faster as someone neared it, and slowed down as they backed away. Red Wolf then left in search of the power source so he could rescue her. Instead he found a large chamber which appeared to be a Buddist temple belonging to King Cycle. Red Wolf then defeated King Cycle's gang and followed Cyle himself through a trap door where Cycle started the Spinning Wheel so it could not be stopped. Red Wolf, however, punched out King Cycle and then smashed the fuse box supplying the Disc, cutting its power and shutting it down. Red Wolf then called the cops to come pick up King Cycle and his vicious gang.

This included and the Iceman forming "King Ice". He and the others were used to confront Access and Doctor Strange, but were ineffective. Once Doctor Strangefate was defeated and the Amalgam Universe restored the combined heroes were split, having no memory of their ever being amalgamated.

king jack.name: King Jack
king jack.origin: King Jack was a cattle owner and a saloon owner who attempted to corner the market of the selling of cattle by killing any cattle owner who crossed the river south of his town. He was able to do this several times until he was confronted by Tex Morgan. Tex rode into town ahead of the cattle rancher who he was assisting. King Jack attempted to hire Tex, but Tex declined. When Tex returned, he was able to trick King Jack. King's men were killed, and he and Tex fought until King Jack was killed.

king leer.name: King Leer
king leer.origin: The man known as King Leer was owner of the Crown Colony Club, a fashionable restaurant that operated during the 1940s. In 1947 he allowed the Gaylord Jewellery Company to send their employee Sylvia Thorp there to show off a $22,000 diamond necklace as an advertising gimmick. Greedily, Leer intended to steal the necklace and orchestrated a plan to do so: When Sylvia had arrived, Leer had one of his waiters spill soup on her and allowed Sylvia to go back to clean up. A "helpful" cigarette girl then removed the necklace while Sylvia was cleaning up and switched it with a phony. Sylvia did not notice, but her employer did and threatened to have her arrested if she did not recover the necklace or cover its cost within three days. When Sylvia attempted to return to the club, King Leer had her barred from entering. She eventually got the aid of Captain America and Bucky who all sneaked in the back way and searched for the necklace in Leer's office. Leer and his men caught them and a fight broke out. Leer forced Captain America and Bucky to stand down when he held Sylvia at gun point. To amuse himself, Leer then forced Captain America to battle Leer's bouncer, a massive brute named Angel. Captain America however bested Angel in a fight, and another brawl broke out. Leer attempted to kill Captain America with an axe, but was tripped up sending the axe flying and smashing a cigarette girl's tray, revealing the stolen necklace inside. Leer, and all staff members involved were turned over to the police and the stolen necklace returned. King Leer's subsequent activities are unknown.

king of all earth.name: King of All Earth
king of all earth.origin: left|thumb|150px An artist is sketching in the park when a pencil drops from a passing flying saucer. He picks it up and draws a bowl of fruit with it and it appears. He discovers that whatever he draws with the alien implement manifests itself as a physical object. His thoughts quickly turn to selfish gain and he draws vast wealth. Not satisfied with only money, he draws himself president. Again, not satisfied, he makes himself king of Earth. He demands his subjects tell him who he is and they reply that he is sovereign of Earth. He laughs, and claims it's all due to this pencil that fell out of a flying saucer. His attendants express disbelief in the existence of flying saucers, and so he draws the craft and it appears. Suddenly, a tentacle snakes out and snatches the pencil as a voice exclaims "There it is! I thought I'd lost it forever." The man begs it not be taken away, but the voice says "You were given unlimited power and you wasted it. You deserve nothing more." The saucer departs and the man finds himself sitting on the park bench with his sketch book as though nothing had happened.

king of all the beasts.name: King of All the Beasts
king of all the beasts.origin: The "King of All the Beasts", an African lion, was the victim of an atomic bomb test. After it regains consciousness, an amazing change has been wrought in the lion's brain due to radiation. It has gained the power of human-like comprehension and seeks revenge upon mankind for nearly taking its life with their weapon tests. Demonstrating a new ability to command all forms of animal life, the lion summons nearby wildlife to a clearing to hear its orders. As the lion plots out a strategy for a comprehensive attack of all animal life upon mankind, the effects of the radiation prove to be temporary, and the lion's ability to reason slips from its grasp. It lets out a mighty roar, startling the other animals away from it, and they go back to their various activities. The now ordinary lion was almost the monarch of the entire planet.

king of castle island.name: King of Castle Island
king of castle island.origin: Not much is known about the so-called King of Castle Island. He claims that one of his ancestors contracted a rare tropical disease that made his blood and skin turn a sickly green. This infectious disease was then passed down from generation to generation. The sole surviving member of his family, the King had and an utterly xenophobic perspective of the outside world. The king had coerced a man simply known as the "Gorilla-Man" (due to his apelike features) into doing his bidding by holding his wife and child prisoner. He had the Gorilla-Man bring him disciples, which he infected with his disease, making them loyal to him. Fearing the outside world, they all carried pills containing a lethal poison in the event they were found. Seeking a bride, he had his slave capture a woman, but part-way through a blood transfusion, she escaped, only partially infected by the disease (turning her blood green but not her skin.) As she fled to the outside world, she was accidentally run down by the Angel who failed to avoid her due to limited visibility caused by a massive storm. The Gorilla-Man reclaimed the girl and brought her back to Castle Island where the King used his scepter to heal the girl's wounds. Before he could get the Ape-Man to torture the girl, the Angel arrived and intervened, but he was overpowered and tied up. The King decided to infect the Angel with his disease as well, but one of his "royal family" members objected to this. The distraction allowed the Angel to break free and fight back again, but he was once more subdued and ordered to be eliminated. Surviving the fall thanks to the aid of the Gorilla-Man, the Angel learned why he was loyal to the king and fought him again before he could continue his transfusion with the girl. During the fight, the Angel liberated the key to the cell that kept the Ape-Man's wife and child locked up. Defeated in battle, the King surrendered, but the ape-man forced him to swallow his poison pill, killing him instantly. The other members of his royal family followed suit, and the survivors all parted company.

The king had coerced a man simply known as the "Gorilla-Man" (due to his apelike features) into doing his bidding by holding his wife and child prisoner. He had the Gorilla-Man bring him disciples, which he infected with his disease, making them loyal to him. Fearing the outside world, they all carried pills containing a lethal poison in the event they were found. Seeking a bride, he had his slave capture a woman, but part-way through a blood transfusion, she escaped, only partially infected by the disease (turning her blood green but not her skin.) As she fled to the outside world, she was accidentally run down by the Angel who failed to avoid her due to limited visibility caused by a massive storm. The Gorilla-Man reclaimed the girl and brought her back to Castle Island where the King used his scepter to heal the girl's wounds. Before he could get the Ape-Man to torture the girl, the Angel arrived and intervened, but he was overpowered and tied up. The King decided to infect the Angel with his disease as well, but one of his "royal family" members objected to this. The distraction allowed the Angel to break free and fight back again, but he was once more subdued and ordered to be eliminated. Surviving the fall thanks to the aid of the Gorilla-Man, the Angel learned why he was loyal to the king and fought him again before he could continue his transfusion with the girl. During the fight, the Angel liberated the key to the cell that kept the Ape-Man's wife and child locked up. Defeated in battle, the King surrendered, but the ape-man forced him to swallow his poison pill, killing him instantly. The other members of his royal family followed suit, and the survivors all parted company.
equipment: The King had a scepter that could heal the wounds of others. How it managed to do this is unexplained.
fields.notes: The Sub-Mariner (Namor McKenzie) fought criminal mastermind Baron Julius Aaroni who is from Castle Island.

king of guildern.name: King of Guildern
king of guildern.origin: The King of Guildern was the monarch of a race of winged humanoid goats who lived on a planet where there was a culture similar to that of medieval Earth. The king was killed by the usurper Mendes, and his son Donal Ban traveled by magical means to Earth, recruiting Nikki Doyle's help to recover the throne.

king of the sewers.name: King of the Sewers
king of the sewers.origin: The King of the Sewers was the ruler of a small community of people living in the sewer tunnels of New York City. Murdering the woman he deemed “queen,” the King chose to replace her with Vanessa Fisk, who had recently wandered into his lair after being presumed dead for months. Thanks to a picture Ben Urich had taken of her when they’d unexpectedly crossed paths, Daredevil and Urich tracked Vanessa to the sewers, where they were forcibly taken to the King by his “subjects” — referred to by the faux monarch as his “maggots.” Upon meeting the sewer liege, Daredevil also came face-to-face with Vanessa, completely submerged in her new “Queen of the Sewers” persona. Rejecting Daredevil’s request to give Vanessa up, the King tried to kill the vigilante and Urich by feeding them to his pet alligator. Daredevil saved himself and Urich by subduing the large reptile, then proceeded to fight the King himself, defeating him with the sewer sovereign’s own weapon. Taking back her wedding ring, which the King had removed from her finger earlier to symbolize their “marriage,” Vanessa declared Daredevil the new King of the Sewers, to the raucous approval of her fellow “subjects.” Daredevil rejected the title, however, instead leaving the sewers with Urich and Vanessa so he could reunite the latter with her spouse, the Kingpin. As part of his bargain with Daredevil, the Kingpin had the mayoral candidate in his sway, Randolph Cherryh, renounce his bid for office, as well as publicly admit his ties to organized crime. The King of the Sewers' defeat left his "maggots" leaderless for a time. In their naiveté, they approached Doctor Octopus, believing him their returned leader. Octavius, who was prowling the sewers en route to another encounter with Spider-Man and Black Cat, angrily rejected the insinuation, and violently lashed out at the sewer dwellers with his mechanical arms. Daredevil encountered the King of the Sewers again after tailing a man in a city shelter, Joshua, into the sewers. Eager to redeem himself before his people, the King challenged Daredevil to a rematch in a sewer dumping pit, but was quickly defeated once more. The reaction of the so-called Maggots to this particular victory of Daredevil's was far less reverential than the last, as they lunged at him in with plans to eat his body. Noting the mercy Daredevil showed the King, namely making sure the self-appointed sovereign wouldn't drown while unconscious in sewage water, Joshua convinced two other sewer-dwellers Daredevil had met moments earlier, Ralphie Jackson and Ed Arthur, to help the vigilante. A Maggot, however, attempted to dissuade them, revealing an alternate agenda: to deliver Daredevil to the Kingpin. As the King recuperated away from all his followers save two, Daredevil learned he'd been manipulated into fighting the King, as not everybody in the underground community supported him. Making the most of the distraction, the King and the two Maggots discovered an altar in the sewers capable of resurrecting another old Daredevil foe, the Devourer. The King performed the ritual to bring back the Devourer, namely killing his two followers as a blood sacrifice. When the Devourer reincarnated in the body of the King's second murdered Maggot, the King promised to feed the monster... unaware that Luther Manning, the former Deathlok, was spying on their pact. While the Devourer joined Bushwacker, whom the Kingpin had hired to kill Daredevil, in battling the costumed vigilante and Manning, the King sent his minions to attack Daredevil after Bushwacker's defeat. Though Daredevil fended them off, the Devourer's renewed attention toward the Man Without Fear prompted Joshua to strike back in his long-retired vigilante guise, Peacekeeper. Though Joshua was successful at holding the Devourer at bay, it was ultimately Manning who defeated the beast, murdering it with flame. The King, still hungry for revenge, demanded Daredevil be handed it over to him, but was dissuaded at gunpoint by Manning. Not content with ending things there, the King of the Sewers later confronted Daredevil one again, this time with several timed explosives strapped to his stomach. Furious, Daredevil knocked the King out and, using his hyper-senses, defused the main bomb, which would have set off the others attached to the King.

fields.personality: Arguably suffering from delusions of grandeur, the King of the Sewers genuinely believes himself the ruler of his subterranean dwelling. A man of great avarice, the King feels everything in his “kingdom” belongs to him, even taking Vanessa Fisk’s wedding ring for himself until she retrieves it. Laid back and self-assured, he looks down upon his followers, calling them his “maggots.” The King is also cruel and a remorseless killer, as seen when he choked his former “queen” to death with his bare hands and sacrificed two of his devoted followers. The King also possesses a great deal of pride, believing Daredevil defeating and saving Vanessa from him have dishonored him -- a value system even the subjects who disapprove of him share.
fields.notes: The King of the Sewers has several, possibly intentional similarities to the Kingpin. Aside from a strong physical resemblance, both characters rule their version of the New York underworld, and were at one point married — or at least believed themselves married — to Vanessa Fisk. A notable difference, however, is that the King of the Sewers is plainspoken, whereas the Kingpin is typically portrayed as an eloquent speaker.

king of the westerlands.name: King of the Westerlands
king of the westerlands.origin: The King of the Westerlands was once a child whose life could have been lost in a shipwreck if not by Angela of Heven, who was hunting for work in the outer galaxies of the Endworlds when their paths crossed. As Angels only make deals, balancing a service for a price, Angela made arrangements with the inhabitants of the Westerlands, where she left the child, to make sure he would grow up knowing that he owed his life to her and that one day she would come to collect her debt. The child eventually grew up to become the King of the Westerlands. After Angela's companion, Sera, was arrested for killing many of the inhabitants of the Westerlands, Angela returned to ask the King to release her and settle their debt, but the King refused, and thus Angela took his life. Following the King's demise, Angela sent payment for the town to pay for the damages inflicted and fund the selection of a new king.

king ra.name: King Ra
king ra.origin: King Ra is the ruler of the Land of Fairies in the potentially imaginary realm known as Nowhere. When he heard that Jimmy Jupiter was the only boy of his generation that could mentally project his body into their realm, he sent his aid the Blue Fairy to bring the boy so that the he could show Jimmy the wonders of his realm. Jimmy lost his way, however when he eventually met with the King, the King made good his offer. After showing Jimmy the royal candy garden he charged Fairy Delight to showing Jimmy around the kingdom. His subsequent activities are unknown.

king snake.name: King Snake
king snake.origin: The leader of a nest of Ghost Snakes, the King Snake terrorized a village of Picts in the Pictish Wilderness. After a group of his snakes encountered, and were slain by, Conan the Barbarian, the Cimmerian was retrieved by the village's shaman, and convinced to fight for the Picts. Conan eventually encountered the King Snake whilst defending the village and the King Snake was slain.

king tiny.name: King Tiny
king tiny.origin: King Tiny was the ruler of the Teeny-Weeny People and was a doting and humorous man. His prime minister Grinko had aspirations to usurp King Tiny's throne. Grinko got his chance when a plane carrying Captain America crashed in the mountains where the Teeny-Weeny People lived. The Teeny-Weeny People helped Captain America recover. King Tiny and Captain America get along, causing most of the Teeny-Weeny People to view him as a friend. Grinko tried to cause his people to riot out of fear that Captain America was a threat. When that didn't work, Grinko caused a flood and planned to blame it on Captain America. During the chaos, Grinko staged a coup against King Tiny. After Captain America solved the problem of the flood, he forced Grinko to confess his crime. King Tiny was placed back on the throne and was promised by Captain America to keep the location of his kingdom a secret.

kingii.name: Kingii
kingii.species: Evolved Lizard (Frill-necked lizard or Chlamydosaurus kingii)
kingii.origin: Kingii was an evolved frill-necked lizard created by the High Evolutionary as one of his New Men, animals given humanoid form and intelligence. He was among the many New Men to stay behind on Earth while his master journeyed into space, and later became an unwitting pawn of the villainous Man-Beast, who sought to overtake the Evolutionary's citadel. After a quick battle with Wolverine, who was in the area searching for Magneto, he was devolved on the spot by the Evolutionary himself, who temporarily returned to Earth to deal with the Man-Beast personally.

kingmaker.name: Kingmaker
kingmaker.origin: When Bullseye faced an army of Hawkeyes and took them all out except for the last one, the mercenary known as Solo; who captured him and brought him to face the mysterious Kingmaker, Bullseye's father whom he left to face a fiery death during their last encounter. Kingmaker prepared to trade his old burned husk of a body for his son's by placing his brain in Lester's body. However, he was unaware that Bullseye's bones were laced with adamantium which, not only was impossible to cut, but also blocked Kingmaker's neural inhibitor. Bullseye battled his way through Solo to get to his dad whom he successfully killed. Ben Urich was scared off from filing a story on the Kingmaker.

kingmaker wallace.name: Kingmaker (Wallace)
kingmaker wallace.origin: Kingmaker is committed to concluding deals with people all over the country, inviting them to fulfill any wishes. Thanks to his connections he could meet the wishes of most people. In exchange for that people helps Kingmaker to meet the wishes of other clients. He made a deal with the Hellions: fulfill their wishes in exchange for a stolen case containing biological weapons. Stealing the case, they handed it over to Kingmaker, but then they changed mind and attacked him. Eventually they managed to win and retrieve the case. Kevin Ford used his powers to neutralize the weapon, after which the Hellions gave the case to S.H.I.E.L.D. agents.

kingo.name: Kingo
kingo.origin: ===Early Life=== Kingo, like every Eternal, was created by the Celestials one million years ago and has looked after humanity ever since. 500,000 years ago, when Kronos attempted to master time, he succeeded but in doing so caused a disruption that destroyed Titanos and threatened the planet. The initial explosion killed Kingo and all other Eternals (except for Uranos), and they all were resurrected and killed several more times before they managed to stabilize the situation, leaving the ruined city superimposed between three seconds from now and two seconds ago. ===Across the Ages=== thumb|left In 1241 A.D., Kingo came across the path of destruction left by the invading Mongol horde commanded by General Subutai that had been sent to conquer Europe by Ögedei Khan, son of Ghenghis Khan. When Kingo learned that Druig was marching with the Mongols, he assumed that Druig was controlling their minds, and confronted him at a campfire. A warrior fired an arrow at him but Kingo just plucked it out of the air. After reassuring the warriors, Druig went for a walk with Kingo during which he revealed that he was not controlling the Mongols and he had had nothing to do with the rise of the Mongol Empire nor their brutally efficient methods but was just there to study them. Druig suggested that, if Kingo wanted to stop them, then he should assassinate Subutai. Kingo later crept into the leader's tent but could not bring himself to do it, fearing that, if he acted to protect the humans from themselves, then he might as well be crowning himself their king. The next morning, Kingo discovered that Subutai and his Horde had packed up their camp and headed home. Not understanding why that had happened, Kingo sought out Druig who had stayed behind. Druig explained that Ogedei Khan had died of a stroke and the Mongols had to return home to select a new ruler. Druig claimed not to have known that that was going to happen but speculated that, if Kingo had killed Subutai, then the leaderless Horde might chosen to not return home and instead continued into Europe, killing thousands more. By the 16th century, Kingo was active in Japan where he learned the ways of the Samurai. ===Modern Age=== thumb|right In the present day, Kingo has parlayed his skills into becoming a major action film star in Japan and elsewhere, loving to portray Samurai. He teleported to Olympia to meet with the other Eternals to deal with return of the Celestials. When the Eternals of Earth chose to leave the planet and explore space, Kingo was one of a small band who remained behind. He joined Ikaris and his allies in trying to stop Warlord Kro from raiding the Pyramid of the Winds. They were unsuccessful in trying to stop the Priest-Lord Ghaur from acquiring the essence of the Dreaming Celestial, and thus assuming the power of a Celestial himself. Kingo and the Eternals joined forces with the Avengers West Coast to stop Ghaur from freeing the true Dreaming Celestial. thumb|left After Thanos was apparently resurrected by a traitor among the Eternals, the Mad Titan began killing Eternals, including the Prime Eternal Zuras, and sabotaging the machines of resurrection at the Exclusion, threatening the Earth's biosphere. Kingo joined the investigation and traveled to Polaria with Thena to question its new head, Druig, after many of its leadership had been killed by Thanos. When Thanos arrived, Kingo and Thena briefly fought Thanos. Once Thanos had retreated, Kingo and Thena concluded that Druig was innocent and focused their attention on Gilgamesh. After Sersi lured out Gilgamesh and Ikaris battled him, Kingo and Thena restrained Gilgamesh with manacles. Gilgamesh was given to chance to prove his innocence and, once he had done so, it was revealed that the traitor was Phastos. As Kingo and his fellow Eternals went to confront Phastos, Thanos was prepared to ambush them. Kingo and his fellow Eternals were able to overwhelm Thanos but then Phastos accidentally teleported him and the others all over Earth while trying to teleport them to the Exclusion to help him fix the resurrection machine he had broken. Ikaris gave his life to use his matter manipulation power to repair the machine. Kingo and the others later learned the reason for Phastos' actions: Eternals were resurrected at the cost of human lives and that the resurrection machines couldn't be turned off without endangering Earth. Kingo and the other Eternals discussed the problem with the newly-resurrected Zuras but realized that it was unlikely that the resurrection process would ever be changed. So, Kingo and other Eternals met with the Deviants in the city of Lemuria, asking how to become like them.

By the 16th century, Kingo was active in Japan where he learned the ways of the Samurai. ===Modern Age=== thumb|right In the present day, Kingo has parlayed his skills into becoming a major action film star in Japan and elsewhere, loving to portray Samurai. He teleported to Olympia to meet with the other Eternals to deal with return of the Celestials. When the Eternals of Earth chose to leave the planet and explore space, Kingo was one of a small band who remained behind. He joined Ikaris and his allies in trying to stop Warlord Kro from raiding the Pyramid of the Winds. They were unsuccessful in trying to stop the Priest-Lord Ghaur from acquiring the essence of the Dreaming Celestial, and thus assuming the power of a Celestial himself. Kingo and the Eternals joined forces with the Avengers West Coast to stop Ghaur from freeing the true Dreaming Celestial. thumb|left After Thanos was apparently resurrected by a traitor among the Eternals, the Mad Titan began killing Eternals, including the Prime Eternal Zuras, and sabotaging the machines of resurrection at the Exclusion, threatening the Earth's biosphere. Kingo joined the investigation and traveled to Polaria with Thena to question its new head, Druig, after many of its leadership had been killed by Thanos. When Thanos arrived, Kingo and Thena briefly fought Thanos. Once Thanos had retreated, Kingo and Thena concluded that Druig was innocent and focused their attention on Gilgamesh. After Sersi lured out Gilgamesh and Ikaris battled him, Kingo and Thena restrained Gilgamesh with manacles. Gilgamesh was given to chance to prove his innocence and, once he had done so, it was revealed that the traitor was Phastos. As Kingo and his fellow Eternals went to confront Phastos, Thanos was prepared to ambush them. Kingo and his fellow Eternals were able to overwhelm Thanos but then Phastos accidentally teleported him and the others all over Earth while trying to teleport them to the Exclusion to help him fix the resurrection machine he had broken. Ikaris gave his life to use his matter manipulation power to repair the machine. Kingo and the others later learned the reason for Phastos' actions: Eternals were resurrected at the cost of human lives and that the resurrection machines couldn't be turned off without endangering Earth. Kingo and the other Eternals discussed the problem with the newly-resurrected Zuras but realized that it was unlikely that the resurrection process would ever be changed. So, Kingo and other Eternals met with the Deviants in the city of Lemuria, asking how to become like them.

kingsize.name: Kingsize
kingsize.species: Kingsize says he's part of a race of "Inhuman giants"
kingsize.origin: Kingsize began his criminal career by attacking The Wasp at a fashion show in Bloomingdale's. In the form of a giant bull, he told her that "her kind" had made life for the "giants...impossible." Claiming to be a champion of the giants, he terrorized Wasp across the store, taking on the forms of a giant frog, a giant snake, a giant bee, and finally a giant spider. With some timely help by the detective Dakota North, the Wasp eventually subdued him. During the super-hero Civil War, Kingsize was among a number of other criminals receiving Skrull organ transplants. He eventually helped Ricadonna escape prison. His current status is unknown.

kingu.name: Kingu
kingu.origin: The first of the Annunaki after his older siblings Lahmu and Lahamu, Kingu was the offspring of Apsû (the embodiment of fresh water beneath the Earth's surface) and the dragon-like Tiamat (the primeval embodiment of the sea). Becoming annoyed by the chaos introduced by the younger generations of Annunaki sired by Lahmu and Lahamu, Apsû planned to destroy his descendants. But the Annunaki water god Ea learned of this plan and preemptively slew Apsû. Enraged, Kingu and his mother Tiamat led armies of his mother's monstrous progeny in an attack on the Annunaki, resulting in a prolonged civil war. During this war, Tiamat's minions stole the Tablet of Destinies from the Annunaki, which Kingu then used as a breastplate, granting him great power that rivaled that of his grandnephew Anu, skyfather of the Annunaki. Leading Tiamat's armies, Kingu laid siege to the Annunaki's home realm of Dilmun, resulting in a long stalemate in the civil war. Ea's son Marduk, the Annunaki god of magic, eventually gained control of Anu's army, broke the stalemate, and slew Tiamat. Marduk then battled Kingu and reclaimed the "Tablet of Destinies" from him before slaughtering Tiamat's remaining followers.

kinji obatu.name: Kinji Obatu
kinji obatu.species: Wielder of the Power Prism given to him by the Grandmaster
kinji obatu.origin: Kinji Obatu was born in Kampala, Uganda, and obtained a PhD in economics from University of Oxford. From that moment on, he demanded to be addressed as Dr. Kinji Obatu, even by close friends and partners. Obatu came to be the Minister of Finance (sometimes called economics minister) of an oil-rich emerging African country, purportedly his native Uganda. Obatu, a prominent figure in his country's politics, had a reputation of being an autocratic, merciless, xenophobic and demeaning man who had his sights in higher positions in the government. He was also corrupt: He required his white business partners, including Americans, to bribe him, and then he insulted them because he knew they needed him more than he needed them. Being discriminatory, Obatu aimed to recruit prominent people for his country, as long as those people were black like almost all Ugandans were (although he did not mind if they were from other countries). The Elder of the Universe known as the Grandmaster, a cosmic-powered gambler, had once won a "contest of champions" on alternate universe Earth-712 using local heroic team Squadron Supreme as his pawns, much to his satisfaction. As the Squadron refused to be the Grandmaster's permanent champions, the Grandmaster decided to create his own superpowered team based on the Squadron in his own native universe for a later contest, a "Game of the Galaxies" against Kang the Conqueror, a time-spanning warlord who ruled an alternate future of Earth-616 on Earth-6311. Kang recruited the Avengers of then-current Earth-616 as his champions, and the Grandmaster time-travelled to a previous point in the past of Earth-616 to create his own team, the Squadron Sinister, reprehensible replicas of the Squadron Supreme created specifically for this fight. The Grandmaster strenghtened his new minions with superhuman abilities by tapping in the Wellspring of Universe Power, a source of alchemical power; the Squadron members would serve the Grandmaster in exchange for this. Besides Obatu, who would become Dr. Spectrum, the Squadron had James Sanders, an immoral chemist, as the Whizzer, and millionaire playboy Kyle Richmond as Nighthawk, as well as an artificially-created Hyperion who was made to believe was the sole survivor of a universe accidentally destroyed by Earth's humans. The Grandmaster found about Krimonn, a Skrull criminal who had attempted a coup against the Skrull Emperor and as a punishment was transformed into a crystal prism, still conscious but unable to act in any way, then sent in a rocket to drift for good in space. The Grandmaster took Krimonn and gave him energy-manipulation powers similar to the Power Prism of Earth-712's Doctor Spectrum (thou Earth-712's Doctor Spectrum's Power Prism was not sentient and Krimonn would remain sentient) then sent the rocket to Earth, disintegrating it just before the impact in Africa for Obatu to find. Although Obatu seemed to merely have bumped on an interesting item on the floor that he deemed valuable enough to greedily grab, he had been actively chosen by the Grandmaster and guided to the Power Prism. By touching the prism, Krimonn bonded with Obatu, their minds in symbiotic contact (and communicating with each other, thou Obatu and Krimonn's personalities eventually clashed with each other, with Krimonn claiming to have chosen Obatu for his willpower that Obatu later lost, and Obatu calling Krimonn a parasite) Thanks to this, Obatu soon learned how to use the Prism's energy-manipulation powers similar to Earth-712's Doctor Spectrum, to channel vast energies in different ways, such as illusions or weapons. Obatu became Earth-616's first Doctor Spectrum (or alternatively it can be considered that Obatu and Krimonn together became Doctor Spectrum) and a member of the Squadron Sinister. This symbiosis was thanks to the Grandmaster modifying Krimonn, and from that moment on, anyone forming a psychic bond with Krimonn/the Power Prism became Doctor Spectrum. Obatu designed the uniform himself. During the Game of the Galaxies, the Squadron Sinister introduced themselves to the Avengers before the fight using astral images so that no team could attack the other before the contest itself, and they revealed their origins (but not their secret identities) to the Avengers. Then, with teleportation provided by the Grandmaster, each member of the Squadron Sinister confronted a member of the Avengers at the site of a celebrated monument in the world, with Doctor Spectrum facing Iron Man at the Taj Mahal. Obatu and the Power Prism argued with each other during the fight, their inner conflict giving Iron Man chances to attack, while they also tried to mock Iron Man. However, as Doctor Spectrum bragged about the polychromatic shield that the Grandmaster had given him, Iron Man understood that the power prism would be vulnerable to ultraviolet radiation, as it exist in a wavelenght beyond the Prism's range of energy manipulation. Iron Man used this knowledge to defeat Doctor

fields.personality: Especially as a finance minister, Obatu was corrupt, greedy ruthless, unyielding and ambitious, hoping to control the country sooner than later. This need of controlling everything was an issue when he had to compete with the Power Prism. He was also motivated by a desire of revenge on those who had wronged him. Obatu later became an agressive criminal, kidnapping and mind-controlling innocents, and threatened to murder people to protect his own life. As a minister, when interacting with foreign partners, especially Americans, he demanded high bribes while mocking them, knowing he had the advantage because the Americans needed his oil. Obatu was openly rude with them, and with anyone he met who was not black. He repeatedly criticized Americans, calling them "imperialist imbeciles" before leaving rudely, and demanded a courtesy that he himself never offered. He also criticized the sentient Power Prism, repeatedly calling him a parasite. While valuing the struggles of black people (even black people from other countries), Dr. Obatu was also prejudiced against people who were not black. He wanted to increase his country's wealth and scientific influence, and was willing to look for other country's help, but he insisted on having an all-black team; when Dr. Obatu tried to hire African American superhero Power Man, Power Man perceived the attempt as racist and discriminatory. Still, Dr. Obatu had not the black people's best interests in mind: He later forcefully kidnapped the ten most influential black people in the United States and have them mind-controlled, to bring them to Uganda against their will and have them strive for the advancement of his dictatorship.

equipment: The Power Prism, which gave him the powers previously listed.
transportation: When he was a Minister, Obatu moved along the United States in an official Rolls Royce. After falling out of favor with the government, Obatu still managed to get access to Mrs. Marley's personal jet for an intercontinental flight
Mrs. Marley was his hostage at that point, but still Obatu had managed to travel from Africa to the United States somehow.
weapons: When Obatu had no access to his Power Prism, he used a traditional handgun.
fields.notes: Doctor Spectrum first appeared in and ; but his civilian identity as Dr. Kinji Obatu made his debut in . That issue include this line to credit a creative contribution: "Credit-where-credit's-due dept: The character of Dr. Obatu is based on a suggestion from long-time Marvelite Steve Perrin! Thanks, Steve! Roy & Mike" In and , the character is only called "Dr. Obatu". His first name, Kinji, was only revealed in . Doctor Spectrum has a one-paragraph profile in , along with the Doctor Spectrum of Earth-712 (Joseph Ledger). As the characters had barely appeared, Doctor Spectrum of Squadron Supreme is described with speculations (He has the same powers as Squadron Sinister's Doctor Spectrum, but possibly different origin, identity and relationship with his Prism). It was later confirmed (in ) that their Prisms are completely different. There are a number of inconsistencies related to Doctor Spectrum that are yet to be explained: , Grandmaster's profile, says that the Grandmaster provided Dr. Obatu with the Prism. In , Obatu apparently finds the Prism and grabs it motivated by his greed. A flashback of the origin of the Squadron Sinister in says that the Avengers defeated and destroyed the Squadron, except for Nighthawk. This is absolutely not what happened in , as the Squadron members all appeared later. In , when Rokk is grabbing Obatu, Obatu explicitly thinks that Rokk's master is Obatu's most bitter enemy, and that Obatu should use this chance to defend himself. That makes no sense because by the following issue (and heavily hinted by the end of that issue), we find out that Rokk was Obatu's puppet all along. In , the Prism leaves the body of Obatu to control a supposed Iron Man (really Eddie March). Immediately, the Prism knocks Obatu out, but he mistakenly calls Obatu "Prism". The Squadron Sinister's profiles in and the flashback in both suggest that the original Doctor Spectrum was still with the Squadron when they confronted the Defenders, but it was a different person. Similarly, the retelling in is misleading, suggesting that the original Doctor Spectrum was with the Squadron in several operations, and that the destruction of the Prism was relevant for his membership (It was not, as other people used that name later as members of the Squadron). Doctor Spectrum's profile in mention how he planned to kidnap the Black Panther and other ten prominent African-Americans. However, per , the plan was to kidnap the people in Daily Bugle's list of "ten most successful blacks", which included the Black Panther - meaning he did not kidnap the Black Panther and ten others, but the Black Panther and nine others. There is an important continuity issue related to Kinji Obatu's last appearance, (1978), in which Obatu interacts with then-President of Uganda Idi Amin, a historical character. Due to the Sliding Timescale, Amin's appearance should be considered a Topical Reference, as Amin historically was deposed in 1979 and died in 2003. This was addressed in different, contradictory ways by the published material: Firstly, Obatu being a Minister in Uganda is not stated until . His previous appearances in only say that he is the economics minister from an unstated West African country. However, Uganda is in East-Central Africa, not in West Africa. (2004), in two appendix entries (Nightspawn and Kinji Obatu), instead suggested that Obatu had had a relationship with (fictional) dictator Eda Arul, of Imaya, seen mainly in (1994). It is the only source that mentions Imaya. Brother Voodoo's profile in both (2005) and (2008) both mention Obatu's escape to "a small African nation bordering Uganda", as had been stated in Marvel Two-In-One #41 because he escaped from Uganda. Imaya, per , borders only Niger and Nigeria. The Squadron Sinister's profile in (2006) and (2009) do not specify Obatu's country, just stating "his native country". Doctor Spectrum's profile in (2011) explicitly states that Obutu was deported to Uganda, and also that Uganda is his native country. References to the Ugandan president's name were omitted, just saying "the Ugandan president". On a related note, in , Obatu ambitions the position of Prime Minister of his country (which had not been yet stated as Uganda); and in , Amin is identified as the Prime Minister of Uganda. However, the position of Prime Minister had been abolished from 1966 to 1980, during Amin's dictatorship. Amin was not Prime Minister, but President for Life (as well as a number of other titles, none of them being Prime Minister). In , Obatu addresses Amin as "Sir". This is not the appropriate protocol; Amin was to be addressed as "His Excellency". It's unlikely for Obatu to make that blunder: Having been a Minister under Amin, Obatu was expected to know these details; and, a few pages before that, Obatu had admitted to W'Sulli that Amin was erratic and that Obatu feared Amin.
fields.trivia: Doctor Spectrum created several advanced machines, including a bomb, a drilling device, a high-tech cannon, an electrically-charged net, and a starship-like vehicle, not to mention several robots. Dr. Obatu was known to have a PhD in economics, but there's no reason to believe that he'd have the technical skills to even design all of these items. Maybe the engineering part came from Krimonn's mind, or maybe the Grandmaster incorporated such capacity in the Prism's alterations. During the battle between Doctor Spectrum and Iron Man in Detroit, which was televised, Happy Hogan revealed to his wife Pepper Potts Tony Stark's secret identity as Iron Man and briefly considered wearing an Iron Man Armor himself to help, risking his own life to help Stark due to their friendship, even if they were having problems at that point; however, Potts convinced Hogan to not do it. After defeating Doctor Spectrum in Detroit, Iron Man unmasked him in front of the police, revealing Kinji Obatu's face. At that point, Iron Man already knew Doctor Spectrum's identity, because Doctor Spectrum's Power Prism had revealed it when telling Iron Man of their origin. While Obatu used his diplomatic immunity to avoid being tried in the United States, he still had a criminal record in the USA - and also in Uganda, as the Ugandan president arrested Obatu after his extradition.

kio.name: Kio
kio.origin: Kio was a space pirate who trafficked four aliens from the planet Vvex because their blood could be used to manufacture the chemical weapon known as YT-19. Venom stole intel on Kio from his vendor, Gholar, and infiltrated his ship. While Kio took advantage of Venom's vulnerability, sonic attacks from a weapon he called "The Scream", the hero managed to open the ship's cargo bay, causing Kio to be sucked out into the Broken Sea by the vacuum of space where he was subsequently eaten by a Were-Fish that was following close to the vessel.
